item.title: SwarmUI v0.9.8 Beta Released as Modular AI Generation Web UI
item.description:
SwarmUI v0.9.8 Beta Released as Modular AI Generation Web UI

SwarmUI, formerly known as StableSwarmUI, has released version 0.9.8 Beta as a modular web-user-interface for AI image, video, and audio generation with an emphasis on accessible powertools, high performance, and extensibility.

#SwarmUI #StableDiffusion #Flux #AIArt #OpenSource

Source: mcmonkeyprojects/SwarmUI
